note: §30 (Third Declension). Transcribed from scan (grammar p. 106, key pp. 57-60). The noun-writing task ('Write the above nouns in cstr. sing...') has no fixed items; key A only comments on it, so it is not itemised. B6-9 unpointed in print (pointed in key).

items.prompt: אָכְלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַפֶּסַח מָתְנֵיהֶם חֲגֻרִים נַעֲלֵיהֶם בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם וּמַקְלָם בְּיָדָם
items.answer: The Israelites ate the passover with their loins girt, their sandals on their feet, and their staff in their hand.

items.prompt: עָשָׂה מַלְכְּכֶם חֶסֶד עִם־מַלְכֵּנוּ וְעִם כֹּהֲנֵינוּ וְעִם־נְבִיאֵינוּ
items.answer: Their king dealt kindly with our king, our priests, and our prophets.
I let mine enemy go and he escaped.
Thine enemy is dead who sought thy life.

items.prompt: וְהָלְכוּ יוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כַּעִוְרִים וְשֻׁפַּךְ דָּמָם כֶּעָפָר
items.answer: And the inhabitants of the land shall go (i.e. walk) like blind men, and their blood shall be poured out like dust.
I will speak no more in his name.
And ye shall take your staff in your hand.

items.prompt: This (is) my son and these (are) my son's sons.
He sent the frogs upon all the land.
All his prophets are dumb dogs, they cannot bark.
items.answer: כָּל־נְבִיאָיו כְּלָבִים אִלְּמִים לֹא יָכְלוּ לִנְבֹּחַ

items.prompt: In Jerusalem is my holy throne.
We took our staves in our hand.
Our enemies dealt kindly with our children.
These are the statutes and the judgments which ye shall keep in the land whither ye (are) crossing, thou and thy son and thy son's son.
items.answer: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְרוּ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבֶן־בִּנְךָ

items.prompt: Their land swarmed-with frogs (acc.) in the chambers of their kings.
